capabilities: Two-way sync Dedao Brain notes with the vault
Search remote Dedao Brain notes from a sidebar
Download image, audio, video and document attachments
Organize output with filename prefixes and date-based paths
Schedule automatic sync and resolve conflicts between local and remote edits
disambiguation: Not a device-to-device vault sync like Obsidian Sync; it syncs notes between the Dedao Brain web service and the local vault.
extras: OpenAPI mode requires a paid Dedao Brain PRO membership; free users must use desktop-only Web mode whose session tokens can expire. Plugin ID remains getnote-importer while the display name is now Dedao Brain Sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull notes from Dedao Brain, and one-time exports leave the vault out of step with the service over time.
